title: Hotel Availability quote tool
description: Versioned request and result shapes for the standalone deterministic Hotel Availability quote tool. Inspect $defs.request and $defs.result without a browser. schemaVersion 2 is canonical; omitting schemaVersion selects legacy input normalization and full details.

isoDate.description: Gregorian calendar date YYYY-MM-DD. Departure is exclusive.

isoCurrency.description: ISO 4217 source or requested currency. Conversion happens only through verified PMS controls.

nativeCode.description: Native PMS code. A supplied code narrows a product; it does not prove entitlement.

name.description: Implemented mappings: refundability, payment_method, accessibility, parking, room_description. Other names stay unresolved.

constraints.description: OR within a list; AND across different fields. Empty lists are invalid.

contextRef.description: Exactly one of native code, exact name, or party-lookup nativeId (optionally with its name). Multiple picker matches are an input gap.

nativeId.description: party-lookup candidate.nativeId for organization or bookingAgency. Not valid for group.

name.description: party-lookup candidate.displayName. Required for agency: the HMS agency picker has no ID filter, so it searches by name and matches travelagencyid.

code.description: Stable issue code. Caller-correctable input is distinct from retryable transport failure.

amount.description: Exact decimal string in minor-unit arithmetic. Never binary floating point.

official.description: Displayed-nightly sums are not PMS totals, tax, fees or payable amounts.

request.description: Canonical schemaVersion 2 request after normalizeQuoteRequest. Absent schemaVersion on input means legacy: preserve property/dates/occupancy, assign group-1.. ids, map root roomCode/rateCode onto each group's required lists, map bed/board aliases and room/flexibility/payment text onto preferred features, and default details to full. Conflicting legacy and v2 fields are input gaps. Child ages 0-99 are a transport bound, not the property's commercial child definition. Daily stays of 1-30 nights and 1-8 occupancy groups are the supported range.

departureDate.description: Exclusive departure. Stay length is charged nights, maximum 30.

id.description: Unique occupancy-group id. Legacy input without ids receives group-1, group-2, ...

quantity.description: Multiplies the per-room occupancy, not a total guest count.

preferred.description: Ordering only. A preference miss is not a hard rejection.

rateContext.description: Optional organization, agency and group references. All supplied contexts must be applied together where the PMS supports that combination. Unsupported or unapplied context yields partial, not a silent public quote.

requestedCurrency.description: Optional. Omission uses property currency. No local FX approximation.

salesStrategy.description: Hotel Availability sales-strategy labels and native property-profile codes. Only strategies configured for the selected property are usable.

includeRestricted.description: Restricted offers are information, not eligible offers.

details.description: summary: source-verified nightly offers and grid facts. full: inspect at most five narrowed offers per group. Legacy input defaults to full. A summary search is not a final payable quote.

maxOptionsPerGroup.description: Return cap after classifying examined source-bound rows. Not permission to claim exhaustive search.

notes.description: Caller context retained as data. It does not authorize actions or satisfy conditions.

normalizedFrom.description: Legacy callers receive this v2 result, not the historical single-option output.

result.description: schemaVersion 2 result. Business outcome is separate from audit capture status. CLI exit 0 means quote, no_match or unavailable with requested capture complete; exit 2 covers partial, input_gap, execution_failure or incomplete capture. outcome quote requires screenshots/group-N-criteria-applied.png and screenshots/group-N-availability-results.png listed for every occupancy group. Missing either path is not a quote.

outcome.description: quote: every group has at least one eligible verified matching offer at the requested detail level, multi-group calls also have a checked allocation, and screenshots lists screenshots/group-N-criteria-applied.png plus screenshots/group-N-availability-results.png for each group. Missing the after-search availability-results png is not a quote. Same for criteria-applied. no_match: complete requested search found no hard-requirement offer. unavailable: verified inventory shortage for the searched product/allocation. input_gap: missing, invalid or conflicting caller fields. partial: useful data with unestablished coverage, eligibility, joint allocation, or a missing quote screenshot. execution_failure: browser or source failure.

requested.description: Normalized v2 request after successful validation. On input_gap this may be the raw caller object, including legacy or invalid fields, so consumers can show correction paths without requiring a valid request.

sourceScreen.description: Hotel Availability and related read-only details. OSRRAV and CRS are not substitutes.

restrictedNights.description: Present only when every matching row of the group is restricted: each requested room type and stay night HMS closes to sale. Restricted rows are never eligible; staff copy names these nights.

label.description: On-screen room name beside the code.
On-screen rate name beside the code.

bundleLabels.description: Observed native nonroom bundle labels only; no entitlement or tax inference.

displayedSum.description: Displayed nightly sum amount already returned by the CLI, or null when the sum is not established.

calculated.description: per-room and quantity-scaled sum_of_displayed_nightly_rates with official:false. Distinct from nullable PMS total, tax, fee and payable facts. Complete dates, identical currency and known per-room basis are required before summing.

allocation.description: status is verified_at_observation, insufficient, not_selected or unknown. Broad multi-group searches stay not_selected. Joint demand uses proven shared inventory pools per night, never summed alternatives.

evidence.description: References into the private audit bundle. Do not embed entire DOM or network payloads.

publicReset.description: Verified public search after a contextual or currency call. Absence of leakage is required. If the bound party has no negotiated rates, public BAR may be returned with issue NO_SPECIAL_RATES; that is not silent fulfilment of a contracted rate.

gaps.description: Legacy path aliases for input-gap field paths.

elapsedMs.description: Wall time for this invocation, including capture finalization.

evidenceDirectory.description: Private local bundle path. Not a public URL.

screenshots.description: Relative paths listed on result.json. outcome quote requires screenshots/group-N-criteria-applied.png and screenshots/group-N-availability-results.png for every occupancy group N.

audit.description: Capture status is separate from business outcome.
